title: Diagnose why two task-sync Git read tests exhaust their real-time budget on a loaded Windows host
outcome: Diagnose why two task-sync Git read tests exhaust their real-time budget on a loaded Windows host
acceptance: task_sync::git::delta::tests::snapshot::complete_cold_snapshot_reads_two_thousand_documents_and_keeps_unverified_envelope and task_sync::data_worktree::tests::evidence::selected_evidence_reads_large_raw_blob_without_changing_code_and_refuses_changed_selection pass in a Windows full gate under ordinary host load, with the cause of their deadline failure in run test-cee0cdbb diagnosed and fixed, never by loosening or skipping either test
